result.title: MiCaDe: Online LiDAR-Camera Miscalibration Change Detection for Autonomous Driving
result.summary: Reliable multi-sensor perception in autonomous vehicles requires accurate calibration between cameras and LiDAR. However, calibration drift is often unavoidable in long-term deployments: vibrations, thermal effects, and minor mechanical shocks may alter the relative pose between sensors, leading to systematic errors in downstream fusion tasks. We propose MiCaDe (Miscalibration Change Detection), an online solution detecting when the extrinsic LiDAR-camera calibration parameters are no longer accurate by means of sequential change detection. MiCaDe requires no calibration targets, or modification of the perception stack, providing low false-alarm rates with negligible computational overhead. Our key insight is that 3D and 2D bounding boxes produced by standard object detectors should remain geometrically consistent under correct calibration. By matching cross-modal detections, we derive geometric consistency metrics that serve as sensitive indicators of extrinsic drift. These metrics are aggregated into fixed-size batches and scored against a reference distribution, producing a likelihood stream that is monitored by a Change Point Model (CPM). Crucially, the CPM accumulates statistical evidence over time, enabling detection of subtle drifts that would otherwise go unnoticed. Experiments on multiple long-sequence datasets and on a real-world dataset with physically induced miscalibration confirm reliable detection under diverse conditions. Code available at: https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MiCaDe.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MiCaDe，一种无需标定靶标、不修改感知流程的在线 LiDAR-相机外参失准检测方法：利用标准检测器输出的 3D/2D 框跨模态匹配得到几何一致性指标，批量打分后由 Change Point Model 累积统计证据，在长序列与实车诱导失准数据上验证检测效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跨模态一致性分数 + 序贯变点累积证据」的可供核查线索，可能对应 LVR 中判断视觉证据或内部表示是否已不可靠、何时触发重新查看或停止的监控机制，但任务域差异较大，需自行判断迁移价值。
